text: わたしの　かれも　きみ　くらい　つよいと　いいのに

structure.jp: きみ　くらい　つよいと　いいのに
structure.en: if only he were as strong as you

patterns.name: 〜といい
patterns.explanation: と followed by いい means 'it would be good if…', a wish. つよいと　いい = 'it would be nice if he were strong'.

patterns.name: 〜のに
patterns.explanation: のに at the end adds regret that things are not that way: 'if only'. いいのに = 'it'd be nice, but sadly no'.

patterns.name: 〜くらい
patterns.explanation: くらい after a person or thing means 'about as much as' them. きみ　くらい = 'as much as you'.
